items.name: oneko
items.title: Oneko
items.description: Cursor-following pixel cat for React (client-only). Based on the oneko.js idea; mounts on document.body with optional bubbles, sounds, and tweakable motion.
items.author: dhrv <https://oneko.dhrv.pw>
items.docs: Render from a client-only entry point, or lazy-load it after mount in SSR-enabled apps. Optional: add sound files under `public/cat-sounds/` if you want full audio; the sprite sheet loads from the upstream oneko.js GIF URL by default.
